answer: Propose one image-labeling slot per ID/day, backed by a distinct certified chip with a non-exportable key. Validators check fresh ID-bound attestations, reject chip-serial reuse that day and spot-check delivered glacier, comet and ember image labels against hidden reference answers. Failure denies the slot. Ten IDs need ten chips despite pooled inference or parallel jobs. Chips are reusable capital; power recurs; no stake. Dishonest issuers can mint fake serials; sampling misses some bad labels. This bounds slots per chip, not identities per owner.
